en-US.author: Erik Zettersten
en-US.description: Capture and edit screenshots and screen recordings on Windows 11.
en-US.longDescription:
Capture a region, window, or display as a screenshot or screen recording.
Annotate images, trim and split video, and add text, images, audio tracks,
and transitions. Export a PNG or MP4 and reopen your work from a local library.
en-US.name: Shnapp
